# Homesrolo

> Homesrolo gives a homeowner one private Home Record for home care, projects, repeatable photo checkups, files, and the decisions that shape a home. Signed-in home records stay separate from the public homeowner guides.

## Start with the home

- [Home care](https://homesrolo.com/home-care/): A practical map for seasonal maintenance, safety checks, home systems, exterior care, and knowing when to stop and call a professional.
- [Home projects](https://homesrolo.com/home-projects/): Plan repairs, maintenance, remodels, upgrades, and new construction; compare written scopes and close out the work clearly.
- [Home record](https://homesrolo.com/home-record/): What a useful property history should remember and how to rebuild the record when details are scattered.
- [Homeowner guides](https://homesrolo.com/guides/): Browse practical guidance by the problem, system, or project in front of you.
- [How Homesrolo works](https://homesrolo.com/how-it-works/): Create a home workspace, add past or current projects, and use repeatable photo checkups.

## Whole-home topics

- Heating and cooling, filters, service, and comfort
- Plumbing, shutoffs, leaks, fixtures, and water heating
- Electrical panels, protection devices, alarms, and lighting
- Interiors, kitchens, bathrooms, paint, floors, and remodeling
- Appliances and their service or replacement history
- Exterior walls, windows, doors, drainage, gutters, and yard care
- New construction selections, walkthroughs, changes, and handoff
- Home safety, urgent boundaries, and when to use a qualified professional

## Roofing

- [Texas roofing center](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/): Cost, materials, contractor checks, insurance boundaries, and Dallas Fort Worth rules.
- [Repair or replace a roof](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/repair-or-replace/): Evidence that separates a durable repair from a complete roof replacement.
- [Roof replacement cost](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/cost/): Why one generic price cannot quote a roof and how to compare actual written proposals.
- [Roofing materials](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/materials/): Asphalt, impact-resistant, metal, tile, slate, composite, and the full roof assembly.
- [Contractor checklist](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/choose-a-contractor/): Documents to verify and questions to ask before signing.
- [Dallas Fort Worth roofing](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/dfw/): North Texas weather, local rules, and project records.

## Roof Watch

- [Roof Watch](https://homesrolo.com/roof-watch/): Check address-specific availability across Texas and Oklahoma; written program limits come before scheduling.
- [Roof Watch homeowner guides](https://homesrolo.com/roof-watch/guides/): Sourced guidance for hail response, roof reports, North Texas heat, ventilation, and selling a documented home.
- [The first 72 hours after hail](https://homesrolo.com/roof-watch/guides/hail-first-72-hours/): Safety, documentation, temporary protection, and prompt insurer notice.
- [What belongs in a roof inspection report](https://homesrolo.com/roof-watch/guides/roof-inspection-report/): A practical checklist for locations, observations, photographs, limits, and next steps.

## Important limits

- A photo checkup can show change between dated views; it does not diagnose a cause or prove that work is safe.
- Homesrolo does not quote a particular home, choose a professional, decide insurance coverage, or act as a contractor or public adjuster.
- Cost figures are dated market benchmarks, not bids for a particular home.
- Permit rules, laws, products, and warranty terms can change. Current sources are linked from the relevant guide.
- Roof Watch is a Homesrolo-coordinated local program performed by an identified roofing professional under written limits supplied before scheduling.
